notes.title: Anonymous Player is now available on Steam!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36055906/70f149593e363b6024c5796a4823eac05b6fdc74.png[/img]

Hi players.

My name is Francesco, and I am the only member and the founder of Tweekie Games.
Anonymous Player was born from my need to tell a story: so many important messages hide behind an apparently very simple gameplay, and I hope you will get them all during your adventure.

If any bugs, errors or problems arise, I apologize in advance and hope they do not ruin your gaming experience. It's the very first time I release a video game, and everything is new to me. I will be here to resolve any potential problem and to answer each question.

Are you ready to face and defeat the Developer?
